svg.title: Issue 10 — Page 7 SPLASH: The Titan — "It is not invisible. It is wrong."
svg.desc: Page 7 splash. Single full-page panel. The Titan fully revealed at extreme low angle from squad's ground position. Angular inhuman dark-surfaced light-absorbing form, dark iridescence at every edge, too many joints, void head. Crouched beneath ceiling. Sickly amber-black device pulsing. Squad tiny at bottom, Thresh's weapon raised. The defining image of the issue.
